sql: SELECT d.x,o.a FROM (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 3) d JOIN t1 o ON d.x=o.a ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.x,o.a FROM (SELECT NULL AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2) d JOIN t1 o ON d.x IS NULL ORDER BY o.a LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1
SELECT d.x,o.a FROM (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3) d JOIN t1 o ON d.x=o.a ORDER BY o.a DESC LIMIT 1
